_comment: Statutory constants only. Nothing here is specific to a person: anything that depends on someone's slab, bank or surcharge band lives in a profile file in the user's own folder, never in this repo. See tax-profile-template.json.

due_dates._comment: Advance tax schedule per Section 208/211 (renumbered 424/425 under the Income Tax Act 2025). Cumulative % of estimated annual tax payable by each date, net of tax already paid this FY.

statutory._comment: The same for every taxpayer. house_rent_standard_deduction_pct is Section 24(a); cess_multiplier is the 4% health and education cess.
